purpose: Document Shashemene's local land-service evidence and bounded anonymous public-source/API checks without treating an unverified configured layer as cadastral coverage.
assessment: The official Shashemene City Administration portal advertises a local Land Management service for parcel search, title verification, and cadastral-request follow-up. The official e-Land viewer exposes a public configuration aimed at Addis (AA-ADS) with a registered-parcel WFS target, but anonymous API access returned 401 and the WFS host timed out. No safe parcel identifier, schema response, or geometry was verified.
